text: Bug: /vitafeed confirm paid message self-txs but skipped token buys. VITAFEED BUYIN was not operator /buy, so LOSE_ZERO (no edge), tier OUT, COST_EDGE, min-entry, and ADD_ON_FIFO_RED blocked the character-sized seat. RISK need ignored buy stake; bal was stale after inscription. Fix: isVitaFeedBuyIn allow path (separate from MANUAL BUY), buy seats before inscribe with live getFullBalance, reserve inscription+stake+gas, stake floor ≥$0.25 leave-behind. Message-first intact when NO SEAT.

hypothesis.note: Transmission revenue seat must buy ≥$0.25 leave-behind + message cost stack without weakening operator leftover/edge.
